pr.title: Add the VNNI K layout and its readers

findings.summary: Read the rendered PR-1 page top to bottom as Ben would (3 Short-version sentences, 84 Words entries, 14 "What this PR adds" rows, 13 walk-through steps, 16 diagram status blocks, 29 change-section rows, 7 gaps), then checked every walk-through claim and line citation against the PR-1 head 82d05e94be (h/tron/tensor/k_vnni.hpp, h/tron/kernels/k_vnni.hpp, kv_cache.hpp, self_attention.hpp, model.hpp, full.hpp, gof.cpp/gof.hpp, the six tests, the CMake and CI files) and the 0.86 ms measurement against the PR-3 diff. The facts and citations are sound: no line number is off, the status boxes of the 16 diagrams agree with each other and with the change-section table (store_block/set_k_block/k_store_* always PR-3, bits/conversions/row-major form always PR-4, qk_vnni_128x4 always PR-2), and the box names in the walk-through exist on their diagrams with two exceptions (k_view/k_at are not drawn on KV_CACHE-B1, fill_storage_slot is not drawn on KV_CACHE-B3). Two must items: the Short version miscounts the data models and misclassifies the scoring-path selection against the table and names no diagram, and the intro step says the PR "adds the FPGA staging gather", which exists in main. The main systematic defect is Words length: 35 of 84 definitions exceed two sentences (counted mechanically); a rewrite is given for every one. Both mechanically unused Words entries are confirmed (runtron is used only inside the "prompt 1024" definition, "scheduler thread" nowhere, while "the scheduler" is used undefined in five places). Rendering: the builder wraps only the identifier in <code>, so call expressions such as page::k_packed(slot, kv_head) render in mixed fonts in about 20 places (one example given; a renderer fix is better than 20 spec edits), and five prose places link diagram ids in lowercase. No "ctx", no "pull request" outside the PR definition, two storage-sense "packed" without "VNNI-".

It also calls "the scoring-path selection with its temporary gate" an algorithm, while section 1 classes it as a policy and lists save_k's per-token store as the third algorithm instead.
corrections.fix: The page introduces four data models (the plane geometry with its index map, the typed owner with its views and one access route, the typed K plane inside the kv_block, and the transfer rows), three algorithms (the per-token store and load, the AVX-512 reader, and the per-token save_k store), and the policies and protocols around them (the layout gate, the page accessors, the FPGA staging gather, the temporary scoring gate and the kill switch).

findings.summary: Read /tmp/claude-0/-home-jhan-workspace-intel-AMX-PR3879-new-PRs-split-4424/05daa18d-ed3c-4a33-8e24-e3eab00ce2ea/scratchpad/out/diagrams-PR2-4887.txt (621 lines) top to bottom, then checked the 3 Short-version sentences, 6 "What this PR adds" rows, 9 walk-through steps, the 9 placed and 7 not-involved diagrams, the 29 change-section rows, 88 Words entries, 5 gaps and the 5 unused-words candidates against the spec, blocks/diagrams.txt (box names), the PR body, the four diffs and the files at the PR-2 head 0ee8671d35 (every file:line the new prose cites was opened; all resolved, two ranges are one to three lines short). Overall state: the page is sound. The walk-through visits the plane (data model) before the kernel loop (algorithm), the A operand before the kernel, and every "say" step names boxes that exist on its diagram. Four items are wrong or inconsistent (must): the Short version counts one data model while the table lists two; the Words entry for set_k_block/store_block says PR 4 removes the present mask, but at PR 4 store_block still takes it and only page::set_k_block loses it (pr4-tensor-k_vnni.hpp:402-425, diff-4901.patch lines 504-507, 929-938); change-section K2 says the save_k consumers of the layout gate land in PR 3 while the page's own Already-there boxes (and model.hpp:3103 at the PR-2 head) place save_k_impl's branch in PR 1; what_lands[0] says K_VNNI-B1 carries the operand-role flip while gaps[2] says no base diagram draws it. Rule violations (should): three multi-claim sentences in the walk-through and status boxes, two why paragraphs that repeat their own In-this-PR box, four storage-sense "packed" without "VNNI-", an undefined "the dispatch note" and "the split plan's U2.1", a dangling number (26.625) and an undefined "token-247 difference", and about 35 Words definitions longer than two sentences (each gets a two-sentence replacement below). Unused-words list: "sliding window", "startOperand / K channel" and "TDPBF16PS" are confirmed unused in the page prose (used only inside other Words entries or nowhere) and are deleted below, with their one useful fact folded into "dense page" and walkthrough[7]; "AMX dispatch (TRON_AMX_DISPATCH)" is used inside the qk_group and README.ci.md definitions (lines 189 and 195 of the text) and stays; "Note [AMX attention dispatch]" becomes used once what_lands[0].where names it instead of "the dispatch note". No "ctx", no "pull request" outside the PR acronym's own definition, no code name split by a <code> wrapper, and the lowercase ids (kv_cache-b1, kv_cache-b2) appear only inside the collapsed Evidence lists as raw hits.txt identifiers. Two template-level oddities are outside the spec: the "Source:" line glues the role to the id ("K_VNNI-B2core"), and the Evidence lists cite hits.txt and files-4887.txt, which the page never defines.

findings.summary: Read the rendered PR-3 page top to bottom as Ben would (831 lines of text, 7 core and 8 context diagrams, 10 "What this PR adds" rows, 76 Words entries, 12 walk-through steps, 29 change-section rows, 5 gaps), then checked every walk-through box name against the 16 diagram extracts and every prose line citation against the PR-3 head dfafd13dce (model.hpp, kv_cache.hpp, common.hpp, tensor/k_vnni.hpp, TronCpp.hs, LoopyTronSpec.hs, t_llama_unit.cpp, t_k_vnni_layout.cpp, llama.hpp, amx_attn_iface.hpp, scheduler/full.hpp, self_attention.hpp, the diff hunks). The flow is sound: data models (K_VNNI-B1, KV_CACHE-B2, MODEL-B1) precede the algorithms and protocol (K_VNNI-B3, MODEL-B2, B3, B4, B5), every "say" step names boxes that exist on its diagram, the status boxes of the 16 diagrams agree with each other and with the change-section table (store_block / set_k_block / k_store_* / save_k_impl in PR-3, every bit, conversion and row-major name in PR-4), the header counts (9 files, +716/-79) and the test facts (4 blocks x 38 masks, 20 ms late helper, finished read at return, unit invariant) are correct, and no "ctx", "pull request" or bare storage-sense "packed" occurs in the new prose. One must-fix: the Short version counts one policy and one protocol and omits KV_CACHE-B2, while section 1 lists two policies, two protocols and seven core diagrams. Should-fixes: the Diagrams column of the block-save row names K_VNNI-B1 whose own box says "nothing" lands there; "split plan U2.1" is undefined; 31 Words definitions run to 3-6 sentences against the one-or-two rule; 20 change-section notes join two claims with a semicolon; one "why" joins two claims with "so". Of the six mechanically "unused" Words entries, three are used in the plural (cache lines, scatters, token lanes: keep), "saved-row bits" is used in the Short version and the KV_CACHE-B4 why (keep, shorten), EAGLE is reached only through the identifiers book::eagle_view_active and EAGLE_STORAGE_SLOTS_1 in the later-PR lists (keep, shorten), and "Note [name]" is a pattern the check cannot match (rename the term). Nits: five off-by-one or over-wide citations, five lowercase diagram ids in evidence lines, "inside save_k" vs "inside save_k_impl", the KV_CACHE-B3/B5/B4 order, undefined hits.txt / files-4901.txt in evidence, and the partial-block path and the tests each described three times.
